description: Designly is a commercial Art Direction and Design Neural Mesh plugin with 21 focused Skills, 16 custom Codex agents, a production Workflow Prompt Library, Cannes-calibrated Creative Direction, 571 Legendary Campaign Canon, dramaturgy-first AI Video Direction (Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo), model-physics Image & Design Direction (Gemini Nano Banana 2/Pro, MiniMax Design, Kimi Design, Claude Design, GPT Image 2), Insight Mining, Brand Activation, Visual Storytelling, Taste Engine, Reference Memory, bounded-edit sanitization, Arabic RTL direction, and independent Visual QA.

defaultPrompt: Open the Designly Workflow Prompt Library and route my real design job through the correct Skills.
Art-direct this campaign end-to-end, using specialist handoffs and strict release gates.

interface.longDescription:
Designly turns a real brief, approved idea, reference set, edit request, or campaign into production-ready visual work through explicit specialist routing

The Workflow Prompt Library provides long-form copy-ready prompts that activate Designly's existing Skills, typed handoffs, fail-close edit contracts, model physics (Gemini Nano Banana, MiniMax, Kimi, Claude, Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image 2), and Visual QA

It shapes creative concepts, dramaturgy, composition, typography, optics, executes through compatible host tools, and routes targeted revisions when outputs fail

You can also sanitize annotation-guided inpainting, follow brand guidelines, handle Arabic and RTL layouts, preserve reference taste without imitation, maintain visual continuity, and install via skills.sh, Homebrew, or npm
